signatures: parseArgs(["--mode", value]) consumes value as Mode
parseArgs(["--model", provider]) consumes provider as startup Provider override
parseArgs(["--privacy-mode", value]) consumes boolean-like Privacy mode values
parseArgs(["--permission-mode", value]) consumes value as Permission mode
ParsedArgs: { mode: Mode; prompt: string | null; permissionMode: ToolPermissionMode; providerOverride: ProviderId | null; privacyMode: boolean }
invariants: Permission mode MUST default to default
Separated Mode values MUST NOT become positional prompts
Separated Provider override values MUST NOT become positional prompts
Separated Privacy mode values MUST NOT become positional prompts
Separated Permission mode values MUST NOT become positional prompts
Permission bypass aliases MUST map through ToolPermissionMode rather than bypassing governance
Unknown Permission mode flags MUST be ignored deterministically

responsibilities: Parse startup Permission mode without side effects
